typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ACTION as string,
		STATUS as string,
		StartDate as string,
		END_DATE as string,
		PATH as string,
		EVENT_ID as string,
		LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT as string,
		PROSPECT_TYPE as string,
		BUSINESS_LINE as string,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		TERRITORY as string,
		MEDIA_TYPE as string,
		SEGMENT as string,
		PROGRAM as string,
		CAMPAIGN as string,
		LEAD_SOURCE_TYPE as string,
		LEAD_SOURCE_NAME as string,
		MEDIA_CODE as string,
		MEDIA_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CREATIVE_CODE as string,
		CREATIVE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		TOLLFREE as string,
		DNIS as string,
		CALL_ROUTING_CODE as string,
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} as string,
		AGENT_NUM as string,
		LG_SUFFIX as string,
		REFERRAL_ID as string,
		REFERRAL_TEXT as string,
		OFFER as string,
		INTERNAL_JOB_NUM as string,
		AD_AGENCYy_JOB_NUM as string,
		AD_AGENCY_ID as string,
		URL as string,
		CID_CODE as string,
		CID_REFERRING_URL as string,
		EXTRACT_DATE as string,
		ATTRIBUTE as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/CampaignUpdate*']) ~> Inbound
DerivedColumn select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive = STATUS,
		StartDate,
		EndDate = END_DATE,
		Media_Path_Name__c = PATH,
		Promo_Id__c = EVENT_ID,
		Lead_Source_Weight__c = LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT,
		Prospect_Type__c = PROSPECT_TYPE,
		LOB__c = BUSINESS_LINE,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c = BUSINESS_LINE_NAME,
		Media_Market__c = MARKET,
		Media_Territory_Name__c = TERRITORY,
		Type = MEDIA_TYPE,
		Media_Segment_Name__c = SEGMENT,
		Program__c = PROGRAM,
		Name = CAMPAIGN,
		Lead_Source_Type__c = LEAD_SOURCE_TYPE,
		LeadSourceName__c = LEAD_SOURCE_NAME,
		Media_Code__c = MEDIA_CODE,
		Media_Description__c = MEDIA_DESCRIPTION,
		Creative_Code__c = CREATIVE_CODE,
		Creative_Description__c = CREATIVE_DESCRIPTION,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c = TOLLFREE,
		DNIS__c = DNIS,
		Call_Routing_Info__c = CALL_ROUTING_CODE,
		Use_CM_Agent__c = {Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)},
		Agent_Number__c = AGENT_NUM,
		LG_Suffix__c = LG_SUFFIX,
		Referral_ID_Req__c = REFERRAL_ID,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c = REFERRAL_TEXT,
		Offer__c = OFFER,
		Client_Internal_Job__c = INTERNAL_JOB_NUM,
		Ad_Agency_Job__c = AD_AGENCYy_JOB_NUM,
		Ad_Agency_ID__c = AD_AGENCY_ID,
		Path__c = URL,
		CID_Code__c = CID_CODE,
		CID_Referring_URL__c = CID_REFERRING_URL,
		Extract_Date__c = EXTRACT_DATE,
		Attribute__c = ATTRIBUTE,
		ACTION
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select
Select filter(upper(ACTION) == 'U') ~> filterU
Select filter(upper(ACTION) == 'N') ~> filterN
ConditionalSplit1@cleanDATA derive(StartDate = toTimestamp(StartDate),
		END_DATE = toTimestamp(END_DATE),
		STATUS = toBoolean(STATUS),
		EXTRACT_DATE = toTimestamp(EXTRACT_DATE),
		REFERRAL_ID = toBoolean(REFERRAL_ID),
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} = toBoolean({Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)})) ~> DerivedColumn
AddADFId split(isNull(STATUS)||isNull(StartDate)||isNull(PATH)||isNull(EVENT_ID)||isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT)||isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_NAME)||(isNull(TOLLFREE) && (upper(PATH) == 'INBOUND'||upper(PATH) == 'IB'))||(isNull(DNIS) && (upper(PATH) == 'INBOUND'||upper(PATH) == 'IB'))||isNull(ACTION)||not(in(['U', 'u', 'N', 'n'], ACTION)),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNULL, cleanDATA)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNULL derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull(STATUS)||isNull(StartDate)||isNull(PATH)||isNull(EVENT_ID)||isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT)||isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_NAME)||isNull(TOLLFREE)||isNull(DNIS)||isNull(ACTION), concat('Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(ACTION), 'ACTION, ', ''), iif(isNull(STATUS), 'STATUS, ', ''), iif(isNull(StartDate), 'StartDate, ', ''), iif(isNull(PATH), 'PATH, ', ''), iif(isNull(EVENT_ID), 'EVENT_ID, ', ''), iif(isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT), 'LEAD_SOURCE_WEIGHT, ', ''), iif(isNull(LEAD_SOURCE_NAME), 'LEAD_SOURCE_NAME, ', ''), iif(isNull(TOLLFREE), 'TOLLFREE, ', ''), iif(isNull(DNIS), 'DNIS', ''), '.'), ''), iif(not(in(['U', 'u', 'N', 'n'], ACTION)), concat(' ACTION column contain invalid value: ', ACTION, '.'), ''))) ~> errorLog
Inbound derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
errorLog select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
filterN sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('CampaignUpdate_Campaign.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		IsActive,
		StartDate,
		EndDate,
		Media_Path_Name__c,
		Promo_Id__c,
		Lead_Source_Weight__c,
		Prospect_Type__c,
		LOB__c,
		BUSINESS_LINE_NAME__c,
		Media_Market__c,
		Media_Territory_Name__c,
		Type,
		Media_Segment_Name__c,
		Program__c,
		Name,
		Lead_Source_Type__c,
		LeadSourceName__c,
		Media_Code__c,
		Media_Description__c,
		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,
		ednc_toll_free_num__c,
		DNIS__c,
		Call_Routing_Info__c,
		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,
		LG_Suffix__c,
		Referral_ID_Req__c,
		Referral_ID_Tool_Tip__c,
		Offer__c,
		Client_Internal_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_Job__c,
		Ad_Agency_ID__c,
		Path__c,
		CID_Code__c,
		CID_Referring_URL__c,
		Extract_Date__c,
		Attribute__c,
		ADFId__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertN

		Creative_Code__c,
		Creative_Description__c,

		Use_CM_Agent__c,
		Agent_Number__c,

	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertU
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('CampaignUpdate_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('CampaignUpdate_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
